title: Export
summary: Writes a complete, consistent copy of the database to a file the learner chooses.
description: The learner can take their data with them, in a file that opens in any SQLite tool.

stories.want: a complete copy of my data without my keys in it
stories.soThat: I can keep it or pass it on safely

requirements.text: Export writes a consistent, compacted copy of the whole database to a file chosen in the system's save dialog.
The suggested file name carries the calendar date: `export.file-name`.
API keys are removed from the copy unless the learner chooses to include them, and are not left in the file's free pages.
This device's sync keys are removed from a copy exported without keys.
An exported copy is marked as a copy: a device opened from it takes a new sync identity.
Cancelling the save dialog writes nothing and leaves no temporary copy behind.

values.description: The file name an export suggests.
